items: A loyalty program pays off when it turns occasional guests into regulars, who visit more often, spend more per check and recommend you to friends.
Choose software that integrates with your POS, online ordering and reservations, and lets guests earn at one location and redeem at another.
Segmentation matters most: identify guests about to churn, guests worth winning back and loyal advocates, then talk to each group differently.
Track repeat visit rate, days between visits, lifetime value by cohort and campaign attribution to see whether the program actually brings guests back.
Momos works on top of your loyalty software so your team can issue points or rewards from a complaint thread and see whether recovered guests return.
